name: talks-over-disclosure-then-hangs-up-late
about: Somebody says hello over the disclosure and puts the phone down seconds after it has finished, part-way through the notice. The disclosure played in full, so it was heard. This fixture keeps the hangup excuse narrow: if a bug ever clears the disclosure, the gate fails closed into silence and the restaurant hangs up into it, and that later hangup must not excuse a disclosure that had already stopped playing. No must_end_call: the text harness ends this call itself and the audio run is ended by the far end, and neither is what this fixture grades.

audio.about: Turn 0 starts 200ms into the disclosure; the far end hangs up at 10 seconds, about three seconds after the disclosure finishes. Only `npm run call` reads this block; the text harness ignores it.
